name: Feya's Swamp

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the Turn Phase of round 4

categories.label: Victory points on score track
categories.hint: VP gained during the game (actions, celebrations, sailing, etc.).

categories.label: Island scoring
categories.hint: Per island: your Settlements there x number of Spirit spaces on that island. Enter the total over all islands.

categories.label: Score cards VP total
categories.hint: Total VP from the 2 score cards in play (largest group squared; 5 per Temple-adjacent Settlement; 3 per island majority; 5 per island with exactly one Settlement; 4 per Settlement on largest/smallest island).

categories.label: Fish on your Settlements
categories.labelVi: Cá trên khu định cư của bạn
categories.hint: 1 VP per Fish still on your Settlement tiles.

categories.label: Mana Gems
categories.hint: 1 VP per Mana Gem in personal reserve.

categories.label: Gold
categories.hint: 1 VP per 10 Gold in personal reserve.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Không có luật phân định: người hòa điểm cùng thắng.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only 2 of the 6 score cards are in play each game (scorer enters 0 for cards not in play). Gold category: enter total Gold; points = floor(Gold/10).
uiHintReason: Six score cards collapse into the single total of the two in play.
winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng. Ván kết thúc sau pha lượt của vòng 4.
